'''Ben Villy'''<ref name="dt-19502">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19502 Careful planning fun deck], DeckTech (Ben "big chief 4" Villy, 26 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19502/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19502/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''big chief 4''', Game Players Network handle '''big_chief04'''<ref name="gpn-3155">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=3155 Walkers on the plains. No objective pile that has won me a lot of games.], Game Players Network (big_chief04, 22 December 2002), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted three [[Light]] lists on DeckTech in October 2001. Villy also published four constructed lists on [[Game Players Network]] between December 2002 and January 2003.
